page.overview:
Who is Luke Pettlework?

"Luke was The King's very first pit crew member. The King's pit stops may have taken a lot longer with only one pitty, but they were done a lot better. For many years now, Luke has had dinner at The King's house every Tuesday night, and their wives are in a bowling league together."

Luke appears at both the Motor Speedway of the South and Los Angeles International Speedway, working on The King's tires while other team members supply him with oil and other tools.

A short Dinoco pitty appears in Cal Weathers team in Cars 3, its currently unknown if that pitty is Luke Pettlework. As the body shape is slightly different and appearently being a newer generation of his model, Its either an entirely different character, or Luke got a drastic body change just like the returning racers7

Luke Pettlework's promo art is reused on a poster for "Pitties Night", however with inverted colours and the team decals removed.
